blocks.text: 87 שַׁחֲרִית לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 87
uncertainties: The header type is small. I did not check its pointing in the enlarged bands; band1 crops it at the top.

blocks.text: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
uncertainties: This line is set in enlarged type. I can't tell whether the bet of בֵיתֶךָ has a dagesh. I left it without one.
סֶּלָה seems to have a dot in the samekh. A meteg may also stand under the he of יְהַלְלוּךָ.

blocks.text: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו׃
uncertainties: I'm not sure the lamed of לּוֹ has a dagesh. A meteg in שֶׁכָּכָה is possible but unclear.

blocks.text: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד. אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃ בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃ גָּדוֹל יְיָ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר׃ דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ׃ הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃ וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה׃ זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד׃ טוֹב־יְיָ לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃ יוֹדוּךָ יְיָ כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרְכוּכָה׃ כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ׃ לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ׃ מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדֹר׃ סוֹמֵךְ יְיָ לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִים׃ עֵינֵי כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃ פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן׃ צַדִּיק יְיָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃ קָרוֹב יְיָ לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת׃ רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם׃ שׁוֹמֵר יְיָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד׃ תְּהִלַּת יְיָ יְדַבֶּר פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ׃
uncertainties: A dot like a period follows לְדָוִד. I wrote it as '.'.
I read נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ and נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ as defective spellings, with no vav after the alef. The second one is less certain.
I don't see a maqaf between יְדַבֶּר and פִּי. I kept them as separate words.
Metegs are faint throughout. Possible spots are וַאֲבָרְכָה, אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה, וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ and הַלְלוּיָהּ. I left them out where I couldn't confirm them.
The text uses the abbreviation יְיָ for the divine name, as printed.

blocks.text: 87 Morning Prayer for the New Year 87
Fortunate are they that dwell in Thine House, they will still praise Thee, Selah. Fortunate the people to whom this happens, fortunate the people whose God is the Lord.

I exalt Thee, my God and King, and bless Thy Name for ever and ever. Every day do I bless Thee and praise Thy Name for ever and ever. Great is the Lord and highly to be praised, His greatness is unfathomable. Generation shall praise Thy works to generation and they shall tell of Thy mighty deeds. The beauty of the glory of Thy majesty and words about Thy wonders shall I utter. Men shall speak of the strength of Thine awe-inspiring deeds and, as for Thy greatness, let me relate it. The fame of the abundance of Thy goodness do they express and exult in Thy righteousness. Gracious and compassionate is the Lord, long suffering and great in kindness. Benevolent is the Lord towards all and Wis compassion is upon all His creatures. All Thy works acknowledge Thee, O Lord, and Thy pious ones bless Thee. They speak of the glory of Thy dominion and tell of Thy might to make known to the sons of man His mighty deeds and the glory of the beauty of His dominion. Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and Thy dominion is in every generation. The Lord supports all that fall and straightens all that are bent. All eyes hope for Thee and Thou givest them their food in its time. Thou openest Thy hands and satisfiest all the living in favour. Righteous is the Lord in all His ways and pious in all His deeds. The Lord is near all who call Him, all who call Him in truth. The desire of those that fear Him does He do and He hears their cry and saves them. The Lord protects all that love Him and destroys all the wicked. The fame of the Lord does my mouth declare and all flesh shall bless His holy Name for ever and ever. We too shall bless the Lord from now to eternity. Halleluyah.
uncertainties: 'Wis compassion' is printed that way; it is clearly meant to be 'His'. I kept the misprint as it appears.
